transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's a pleasure to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Um... well, I guess I just don't have the push I used to. I used to go to choir... and do quilting... visit folks. But lately, I just sit at home. The TV's on low. I know people are expecting me, but... I just stay home.
Have you experienced periods like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I haven't thought about it much. I just... I don't remember feeling exactly like this. It's just how things are right now.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your memory, such as forgetting recent conversations or where you've placed things?
Um... no. I don't think so. My things are usually right where I left them. I just... I haven't really noticed any trouble with that.
Looking back over the last several years, have there been any other times in your life where you felt this same lack of energy and interest for a period of at least two weeks?
Um... no. Not that I can think of. Like I said, I just... I don't think so. It's just been lately.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite lately?
Um... no. I eat about the same, I guess. I haven't really paid much mind to it.
Could you tell me how much this lack of energy and interest has interfered with your ability to get through your daily tasks or do the things you are responsible for?

Well... I suppose it's made some things harder. I... I had to step back from leading the choir. And the projects at the senior center... I just couldn't keep up with what I said I'd do. The folks from church... they check in on me more now than they used to. So... yes, it's been a bit difficult.
Aside from the lack of energy and interest you've mentioned, have you been feeling particularly worthless or guilty about anything lately?
No... I wouldn't say that. I just... I don't feel like doing much, that's all. Not guilty, really. Just... tired.
Have you been having any trouble sleeping lately, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up much earlier than you intended?
No... my sleep is fine. I just... I sleep when I'm tired. I don't really have trouble with it.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to concentrate or focus on things like reading the paper or following a television program?
No... not really. I can still watch my shows just fine. I don't... I don't read the paper much anyway. So... no, that's fine.
Have you noticed if your movements or your speech have become noticeably slower than they used to be?
No... I don't think so. I just... move around like I always do. I'm not in a hurry or anything, but... no, it's not slower. And my talking is fine.
Have you seen a doctor recently to check if you have any physical health problems that might explain why you are feeling so tired?
No... I haven't seen a doctor. I mean... you're the doctor. I just... I haven't been anywhere else.
Have you been feeling physically exhausted or worn out even when you haven't been doing anything active?
No... not really. I mean, I sit a good bit, but... I don't feel worn out. Just normal, I guess.
Could you tell me roughly how many months or years you have been feeling this way?
Well... a little over two years, I suppose. It's just... been building since I retired. From the school office.
